title: Customer signup months
statementMd:
How many customers signed up in each month (format YYYY-MM)? Earliest month first.

Expected columns: `month`, `signups`.

Tables: `customers`, `products`, `orders`, `order_items`.

**Row order matters** for this problem.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT strftime('%Y-%m', signup_date) AS month, COUNT(*) AS signups FROM customers GROUP BY month ORDER BY month;
```
